title: Longest Rearrangeable Mirror Stretch
description:
## Task

Find the longest contiguous piece of `s` whose letters can be reordered into a palindrome. Only the counts of letters matter: a piece qualifies when at most one letter occurs an odd number of times.

## Input

- `s` — a string of lowercase letters. It may be empty.

## Output

The length of the longest qualifying piece. An empty string gives `0`; a non-empty string always gives at least `1`.

## Example

```python
longest_mirror_stretch("abcab")  # returns 5
longest_mirror_stretch("abcd")  # returns 1
longest_mirror_stretch("xyzzyq")  # returns 5
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `s` ≤ 10^5
- `s` contains only the lowercase letters `a`-`z`.
- Checking every piece one by one is too slow for the largest inputs.
